summary: Router 0.31.1 (ADR-0095): when the scheduler picks a cloud tier, _Acquire.next_candidate first waits once for a running router-triggered load of a local tier ranked before that cloud tier (existing _wait_for_load, now given the tier slice), at most until the request's admission deadline, then selects again. The change only delays or avoids a cloud pick; it adds no route, configuration key, destination or payload change. After the wait the request goes through scheduler.choose again, so Routing.tier_blocked (data class, client floor, provider guards, privacy opt-in) still decides every cloud tier. CI gains one self-test run.

findings.evidence: The cloud tier is still chosen only through scheduler.choose, which calls req.tier_blocked for every tier on each selection, including the re-selection after the wait (proxy.py next_candidate loop).
findings.resolution: No bypass: the change can only replace a cloud pick by a local one, never add a cloud pick. Fewer requests leave the house during model loads.

findings.evidence: A request may now wait for a load where it previously went to the cloud at once. The wait reuses _wait_for_load: once per (node, model) via waited_loads, polling every 0.5 s, bounded by the admission deadline (routing.deadline_ms or max_wait_*), holding no node slot.
findings.resolution: Bounded as the existing no-candidate load wait. As before for that path, requests waiting for a load are not counted in admission's max_queue; this is pre-existing and unchanged in kind. Cloud cost exposure decreases.

findings.evidence: ci.yml adds `python test/selftest_cloud_wait_for_load.py` to the existing test job; no new action, permission, secret or trigger.
findings.resolution: No change to CI trust; the test runs without network, router process or credentials.

tests.evidence: all PASS (11 checks); with proxy.py reverted to origin/main 4 checks fail (instrument validated).

tests.command: python test/selftest_standby_switch.py; selftest_system_append.py; selftest_privacy_check.py; selftest_openai_node_standby.py; selftest_context.py; selftest_memory.py
tests.evidence: each reported its pass line with exit code 0.

tests.command: ruff check .; python test/check_adr_index.py; python test/selftest_control_flow.py; python test/check_control_flow.py; python test/selftest_english_names.py
tests.evidence: All checks passed; ADR index ok: 95 ADRs; control flow ok: 0 legacy findings.

limitations: The behaviour during a real model switch is verified after rollout by the staged-question measurement named in ADR-0095, not by this change.
The full self-test suite runs in CI; locally only the tests listed above were run.
